create_EmDataset_for_query_embedding: create an EmDataset instance to tokenize and embed query texts from a JSON data file
create_EmDataset_for_document_corpus: create an EmDataset instance to tokenize and embed a document corpus from TSV or JSON files
use_em_collate_for_batching: use the em_collate function to batch tokenized samples into padded input_ids and attention masks
use_normalize_for_unicode_text: use the normalize function to resolve different unicode encodings in text with NFD normalization
use_convert_brc_for_bracket_tokens: use the convert_brc function to replace bracket token placeholders like -LRB- with actual parentheses
